newsitem.title: USA: Dlr impact on US trade hard to quantify -Ehrlich.
newsitem.headline: Dlr impact on US trade hard to quantify -Ehrlich.

text.p: Undersecretary of Commerce for Economic Affairs Everett Ehrlich said Thursday it was difficult to quantify the impact the strong dollar had on the January trade data.

Ehrlich told a news conference after the department reported the U.S. trade deficit hit its highest level in more than nine years in January that the strong dollar might have had an impact, but that it was hard to say how much.

"It's hard to separate it from other factors operating in the deficit at this time," said Ehrlich. "We've seen the deficit increase in the last several months and that is coincident with some changes in exchange rates.
"It is also coincident with changes in growth differentials as the U.S. economy accelerated in the fourth quarter of last year and apparently in the first quarter of this year as well," he said.
The department reported that the January deficit shot up 21.1 percent to $12.71 billion after a revised 31.6 percent jump in December.
